result.finding: Java 8 (JRE) runtime on Debian Linux via Eclipse Temurin (Adoptium). Spring Boot 2.7.18 embedded Tomcat serves as the application server. Maven 3.9.6 used for build.
evidence: Dockerfile build stage: FROM maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 (Maven 3.9.6 + JDK 8)
Dockerfile runtime stage: FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre (Adoptium OpenJDK 8 JRE, Debian-based)
ENTRYPOINT: java $JAVA_OPTS -jar app.jar (Spring Boot executable JAR)
